summary.text: Gene Yaw is a Republican who has represented Pennsylvania's 23rd Senatorial District (Bradford, Lycoming, Sullivan, Tioga and Union Counties) since being elected in November 2008; he chairs the Senate Environmental Resources and Energy Committee and is vice chairman of the Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Before running for the Senate, Yaw served as Lycoming County solicitor for 17 years and was named County Solicitor of the Year in 2004. He has also been general counsel to the Pennsylvania College of Technology for more than 20 years and was elected chairman of its board in 2013.
He serves "Of Counsel" with the McCormick Law Firm in Williamsport.

A U.S. Army veteran, Yaw graduated from the United States Artillery and Missile Officer Candidate School at Fort Sill, Oklahoma, served an overseas tour as an artillery officer, and was honorably discharged as a 1st Lieutenant. He graduated from Montoursville High School, attended Bucknell University, and earned degrees from Lycoming College and the American University School of Law.

In the Senate he also serves on the Agriculture & Rural Affairs, Banking & Insurance, Community, Economic & Recreational Development, and Rules & Executive Nominations committees, and chairs the Center for Rural Pennsylvania.
He is a Loyalsock Township resident, married to Ann S. Pepperman, and they have two children and four grandchildren.
